stem.text: A diffraction grating is used to measure the wavelength of monochromatic light.
The spacing of the slits in the grating is $1.15 \times 10^{-6}\,\text{m}$. The angle between the first order diffraction maxima is $60.0^{\circ}$, as shown in the diagram.

stem.alt: Diagram of monochromatic light incident on a grating, with two diffracted rays leaving the grating at an angle labelled 60.0°, and labels monochromatic light and grating.

stem.text: What is the wavelength of the light?
